zh: 合法的出现位置只有四类：某一行、某一列，以及它们的反向串；单词必须是其中某条线上的连续片段。
先把所有行、所有列及它们的反转都整理成码点序列，再对每个单词用 KMP 在这些线上逐条查找；相同单词的结果可以缓存。
用 JSON 解析出网格行和单词列表，按 Unicode 码点处理（不要按字节）；构造 2×(行数+列数) 条搜索线；对每个未缓存的单词计算前缀函数，依次在每条线上做 KMP 匹配，找到即为 Yes；按查询顺序输出 Yes 或 No。
en: There are only four kinds of legal placement: a row, a column, or either of them reversed; the word must be a contiguous piece of one of these lines.
Turn every row, every column and their reversals into code-point sequences, then search each word on these lines with KMP; repeated words can reuse a cached result.

Parse the grid rows and the word list from the JSON and work on Unicode code points (not bytes); build the 2 * (rows + columns) search lines; for each word not yet cached compute its prefix function and run KMP on each line, answering Yes on the first match; print Yes or No in query order.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Precompute all rows, all columns and their reversed strings. Build a KMP prefix table for every word and search for it on these strings one by one; cache the result for repeated queries of the same word.

## Proof of correctness

All legal directions correspond exactly to the four kinds of lines: rows, columns and their reversals, and a contiguous match on a search line is exactly a straight, non-turning segment as the problem requires. KMP only skips positions already proven unable to start a match, so it does not change whether a match exists.

## Complexity

O(KNM + total word length) time, O(NM + total word length) space.
